WITH
-- Şehirler tablosu: Tüm müşterilerin şehirlerini içerir (sadece kayıt olmuş müşteriler)
city_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sehir FROM musteriler
),
-- Şehir bazlı en az bir sipariş vermiş farklı müşteri sayıları (en az 1 sipariş olanlar)
city_orders_count AS (
    SELECT 
        m.sehir,
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) as musteri_sayisi
    FROM musteriler m
    INNER JOIN siparisler s ON m.id = s.musteri_id
    GROUP BY m.sehir
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) >= 1
),
-- Şehir bazlı toplam cirolar (iadeler dikkate alınmadan)
city_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        s.musteri_id,
        SUM(sk.adet * sk.birim_fiyat) as sehir_cirosu
    FROM siparisler s
    INNER JOIN siparis_kalemleri sk ON s.id = sk.siparis_id
    GROUP BY s.musteri_id
),
-- Şehir bazlı toplam ciroyu hesapla
city_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        m.sehir,
        COALESCE(SUM(t.ciro), 0) as toplam_ciro
    FROM musteriler m
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT musteri_id, sehir, ciro 
        FROM city_customers cc 
        INNER JOIN city_revenue tr ON cc.id = tr.musteri_id
        CROSS JOIN city_customers cc2 WHERE cc.sehir = cc2.sehir
    ) t ON m.id = t.musteri_id
    GROUP BY m.sehir
)
-- Daha temiz yaklaşım: CTE zinciri
WITH 
all_cities AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sehir FROM musteriler
),
cities_with_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.sehir
    FROM musteriler m
    INNER JOIN siparisler s ON m.id = s.musteri_id
),
customer_counts_per_city AS (
    SELECT 
        m.sehir,
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) as musteri_sayisi
    FROM musteriler m
    INNER JOIN siparisler s ON m.id = s.musteri_id
    GROUP BY m.sehir
),
city_revenue_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        s.musteri_id,
        SUM(sk.adet * sk.birim_fiyat) as musteri_cirosu
    FROM siparisler s
    INNER JOIN siparis_kalemleri sk ON s.id = sk.siparis_id
    GROUP BY s.musteri_id
),
city_revenue_totals_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        m.sehir,
        SUM(cr.musteri_cirosu) as toplam_ciro
    FROM musteriler m
    INNER JOIN customer_counts_per_city c ON m.sehir = c.sehir
    INNER JOIN city_revenue_totals cr ON m.id = cr.musteri_id
    GROUP BY m.sehir
)
SELECT 
    ac.sehir,
    COALESCE(ccpc.musteri_sayisi, 0) as musteri_sayisi,
    COALESCE(crt.total_ciro, 0) as toplam_ciro
FROM all_cities ac
LEFT JOIN customer_counts_per_city ccpc ON ac.sehir = ccpc.sehir
LEFT JOIN city_revenue_totals_agg crt ON ac.sehir = crt.sehir
ORDER BY toplam_ciro DESC, sehir ASC;

WITH
-- Tüm şehirler (sadece kayıt olmuş müşterilerin şehirleri)
cities AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sehir FROM musteriler
),
-- Şehir bazlı en az bir sipariş vermiş farklı müşteri sayıları
city_order_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        m.sehir,
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) as musteri_sayisi
    FROM musteriler m
    INNER JOIN siparisler s ON m.id = s.musteri_id
    GROUP BY m.sehir
),
-- Şehir bazlı toplam cirolar (iadeler dikkate alınmadan)
-- Önce her müşterinin cirosunu hesapla
customer_revenues AS (
    SELECT 
        s.musteri_id,
        SUM(sk.adet * sk.birim_fiyat) as ciro
    FROM siparisler s
    INNER JOIN siparis_kalemleri sk ON s.id = sk.siparis_id
    GROUP BY s.musteri_id
),
-- Şehir bazlı ciroları topla
city_revenues AS (
    SELECT 
        m.sehir,
        SUM(cr.ciro) as toplam_ciro
    FROM musteriler m
    INNER JOIN customer_revenues cr ON m.id = cr.musteri_id
    GROUP BY m.sehir
)
SELECT 
    c.sehir,
    COALESCE(coc.musteri_sayisi, 0) as musteri_sayisi,
    COALESCE(cr.toplam_ciro, 0.0) as toplam_ciro
FROM cities c
LEFT JOIN city_order_counts coc ON c.sehir = coc.sehir
LEFT JOIN city_revenues cr ON c.sehir = cr.sehir
ORDER BY toplam_ciro DESC, sehir ASC;

),

    FROM siparisler s
    INNER JOIN siparis_kalemleri sk ON s.id = sk.siparis_id
    GROUP BY s.musteri_id
),

    FROM musteriler m
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT musteri_id, sehir, ciro 
        FROM city_customers cc 
        INNER JOIN city_revenue tr ON cc.id = tr.musteri_id
